text: Free demo: tens of thousands of adorable creatures are coming for you.
They are adorable. This changes nothing.
You man huge guns and carve visible holes through crowds that cover whole hillsides.
Every run earns permanent upgrades, so the wave that beat you becomes a massacre.
Best part: the scale. A sea of cute little blobs, splattering like paint.
The catch? The walls and levels look flat and unfinished, like a prototype.
The Windows demo is under four hundred megabytes, in fifteen languages, with the full game due November.
Think Vampire Survivors, in first person, with artillery.
Worth a dip. Don't make eye contact.
